description_en: Retrieves the details of an entity
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-entity-info --entity-id 12345 --entity-identity test22.php --incident-uuid 85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000 --sophon-task-id 577bbf90-a770-44a7-8154-586aa2d318fa --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEntityInfo

parameters.help_en: The logical ID of the entity
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The feature value of the entity. You can perform a fuzzy search for the entity
parameters.help_zh: 实体特征值，可以对处置实体进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: entity_identity

parameters.help_en: The globally unique UUID of the event
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SOAR response policy
parameters.name: sophon_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. The administrator can use this ID to switch to the view of this member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
